finding.evidence: The published statement assumes only f in L¹([a,b]) and evaluates f(x), but def-l-p-space-as-a-quotient-by-null-functions defines L¹ elements as almost-everywhere equivalence classes (Definition, lines 42–43). The proof chooses a representative when extending f by zero (Proof 1.1) and establishes the derivative identity on a full-measure set (Proof 2.1). Specify a measurable representative and state equality almost everywhere for it. The assigned example needs only this almost-everywhere form, so the finding is nonfatal to that example.
